reason: I already pay for magic apps, and a Hebrew one that works offline and hides the word in my own gallery, notes or calculator is exactly what I'd show off at Friday dinner. 99 ₪ one time is less than a night out, so if the free tricks work smoothly on my phone I'll buy it that week.
objection: I'm not a magician, I'll fail in front of everyone. And it installs from the browser, not the App Store, and I pay by card on some website, so I'm not sure it's legit or that it won't break after an update.
would_change_my_mind: If the free tricks felt clunky or obvious when I tried them on my sister, I wouldn't pay.
